information: Gramin Krishi Mausam Seva (GKMS) from the Agricultural Meteorology Division aims to minimise the impact of adverse weather on crops. Agromet advisories are disseminated to farmers; state-capital forecasting offices issue forecasts and advisories.

Farmers can access advisories via MAUSAM app, Meghdoot Agro app and UMANG app (Android and Apple), the agromet website imdagrimet.gov.in, the state-wise advisories page, and state-capital forecasting offices.

information: National significance pests: yellow stem borer, brown planthopper, white-backed planthopper, leaf folder, gundhi bug, gall midge. Diseases of national importance: blast, bacterial leaf blight, sheath blight, false smut, brown spot. Regional: termite, rice hispa, armyworm, thrips, mealybug, mites, white grub, sheath rot, bakanae, stem rot, tungro. Also nematodes, weeds and rats.
Field observations on pests and diseases start about 20 days after transplanting. Farmers record plant health, pests, natural enemies and weather through Agro-Ecosystem Analysis (AESA).
